prompt:
TASK:
Create one production-ready sticker sheet containing exactly 4 game sprites.

PROJECT CONTEXT:
Neon Alley: Night-market street vendor sim in a rainy cyberpunk city, run by cats.

STYLE:
STYLE LOCK: A cosy cyberpunk night market run by cats.

PRIMARY GOAL: Cute, soft sprites for a phone game with a flat top-down street map where every object stands up and faces the camera. The city is a friendly place at night: chunky machines, glowing panels, round cats.

CORE AESTHETIC: Lineless, softly shaded colour blocks, like a cosy kawaii game moved to a neon city. Chunky, pillowy, rounded machines in deep indigo (#3B3F7A) and plum (#6A4A8C), lit by flat glowing panels in cyan, coral and amber. Cats are cream-white with small patches, a wide head, small rounded ears, tiny dark dot eyes, no tail.

EDGES: NO OUTLINES. No dark contour line around any shape. Shapes are separated by colour alone. Where a shape meets a similar colour, it has a darker band of its own hue along its lower edge. Panel detail is a darker same-hue shape, never a line. The only dark colour is tiny eyes.

COLOR: Bodies in indigo (#3B3F7A) with a darker band (#2A2C5C), plum (#6A4A8C) and steel blue (#7C8DB5). Light panels in neon cyan (#4FE3F0), hot coral (#FF5E7A) and amber (#FFB84D). Cats and cloth in cream (#FFF4E6). Never green: the background is pure #00FF00.

SHADING: Soft cel shading. A darker same-hue band on the lower side of every form, and a soft cyan or coral light along the edge nearest a glowing panel. Glow stays inside the object. No bloom, no rain, no fog.

VIEW AND PROPORTION: Front-facing oblique. Each object shows its full front face and a thin sliver of its top. Objects stand on a flat bottom edge. Chunky, short proportions.

DETAIL LEVEL: Readable at very small sizes. Signs show simple glyph shapes, never readable text. No tiny panels or cables.

COMPOSITION: One asset category per image. Every asset isolated on flat #00FF00 with generous crop-safe spacing, no scene, no ground.

PALETTE:
Chroma #00FF00 (background), Indigo #3B3F7A (fill), Indigo Band #2A2C5C (shade), Plum #6A4A8C (fill), Neon Cyan #4FE3F0 (fill), Hot Coral #FF5E7A (fill), Amber #FFB84D (fill), Cream #FFF4E6 (fill), Cream Band #E3D3C4 (shade), Steel Blue #7C8DB5 (fill)

SHAPE LANGUAGE:
chunky, pillowy, big rounded corners, soft boxy machines, round kawaii cats with no tail, front-facing with a sliver of top, flat bottom edge

RENDERING RULES:
- no outlines: colour blocks separated by colour alone
- a darker same-hue band on the lower side of every form
- a soft coloured light on the edge nearest a light panel
- glowing panels are flat bright colour; any glow stays inside the silhouette
- signs show simple glyph shapes, never readable letters
- cats are cream-white with small patches, tiny dot eyes, no tail
- chunky pillowy shapes with big rounded corners
- front-facing oblique view: front face plus a sliver of the top
- never use green anywhere on a subject; the background is pure
- crisp high-resolution raster
- isolated presentation with large spacing

CATEGORY:
Tall night-market street pieces

EXACT ASSETS:
1. a chunky indigo vending machine with a glowing cyan window of drinks
2. a plum noodle stall with a glowing coral awning and a cream curtain
3. a street lamp post with a round amber light
4. a tall indigo sign tower with stacked cyan, coral and amber glyph panels

CANVAS AND LAYOUT:
Output size 1024x1024. Solid flat background #00FF00 with no texture, no vignette, no border. Nothing in the picture may use a colour close to the background colour.
The game shows each asset in a 2:1 (width:height) frame. Compose each asset to suit that frame, and keep its natural proportions: do not stretch or squash it.
Arrange the assets in a neat grid in reading order (left to right, then top to bottom), one asset per cell.
Keep every asset isolated.
Do not let assets touch or overlap.
Use front-facing views only.
Leave generous crop-safe spacing around every asset, at least one asset-width apart.
No labels, text, numbers, scene, ground line, or decorative filler.

SPRITE RULES:
Use strong, rounded silhouettes that remain readable at 48x48px.
Use no more than 4 base colours per asset, plus their shading tones.
Soft night shading: each form has a darker same-hue band on its lower side and a soft coloured light along the edge nearest a light panel. Light panels are flat bright colour with a soft glow that stays inside the object's silhouette. Never harsh, never metallic, never chrome.
Avoid tiny details, intricate textures, and visual clutter.
No outlines: shapes are colour blocks separated by colour alone, with soft rounded edges and a darker same-hue band on the lower side; the only dark marks are tiny eyes.
Keep the palette, edge treatment, proportions, and detail level consistent across the whole sheet.
Draw every asset at a similar visual scale.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
outlines, dark outlines, black outlines, ink lines, line art, contour lines, sticker outline, hard vector edges, green on the subject, glow outside the silhouette, bloom, lens flare, rain, fog, smoke, chrome, metallic sheen, glossy reflections, harsh shading, gritty texture, grunge, realism, 3D render, isometric view, three-quarter turn, readable text, letters, numbers, kanji, tails, big anime eyes, long limbs, scene background, ground plane, clutter, tiny details, watermark

FINAL CHECK:
Exactly 4 assets.
Every requested asset is present once, in the listed order.
Every asset is separate, readable, and crop-safe.
